newsitem.title: UK: Kleinwort Benson cuts C&W to sell from hold.
newsitem.headline: Kleinwort Benson cuts C&W to sell from hold.

text.p: Broker Kleinwort Benson on Monday downgraded shares in Cable and Wireless Plc to a "sell" recommendation from a "hold", dealers said.
The analyst covering C&W was not immediately avalaible to comment.
C&W shares fell six pence to 566 after having gained 76 pence on Friday following news the company had struck a pact with China Telecom.
C&W will sell 5.5 percent of Hong Kong Telecommunications to China Telecom, while gaining the opportunity to take part in the Chinese telecoms market.
